scope: Strict full-capacity byte-compatible ownership transformation;ordinary safe CUDA batch comparator;no novelty or production admission

hardware.model: NVIDIA RTX PRO6000 Blackwell Server Edition
hardware.placement: live idle card with matched NUMA;private placement

micro.insert_preparation: Untimed deleteK in fixed512-row chunks;then8 query warmups before formal insert
micro.replacement: K original deletes andK fresh occurrence inserts;ACK per complete batch pair
micro.payload: Same inherited W2 victims and coordinate-rotated incoming vectors,firstK only
micro.queries: 8 warmups plus32 final exact validation queries,all outside micro ACKs
micro.mean_policy: Frozen initial PDX means throughout;no eager maintenance

whole_service.workload: Exact unchanged parentW2,500k replacements,1M point updates,160 formal queries,8 warmups
whole_service.binary: Pinned immutable parent binaries remeasured,not historical timings

instrumentation.primary: Unprofiled Host-ready ACK;candidate audit/counters/plan cost included
instrumentation.calibration: 36 MARKED R/B1/B512 processes paired to the identical36 primary PLAIN cells;one frozen source/compiler,6rounds
instrumentation.profile: NSYS and NCU diagnostic-only,separate targets;no API time equated to pure CPU computation

measurement.primary: Whole Host-ready operator ACK;all validation,bookkeeping,audit appends,copy submission and required stream wait included
measurement.replacement: True pair ACK plus nested delete/insert sub-ACKs;do not add both
measurement.stats: 6-process median of within-process mean,p50,p95;finite samples,not SLA
measurement.paired: 6 matched rounds;median ratios and paired process geometric ratios;20000 bootstrap resamples,seed2026101511;effect size,uncertainty and scope separately reported
measurement.orders: all micro cells and PLAIN/MARKED pairs forward/reverse alternate6 rounds
measurement.traffic: CUPTI actual transfer bytes/durations separate from sampled DRAM interface activity;no exact DRAM/L2 bytes inferred
measurement.kernel_metrics: Only actual application kernels;none expected inside frozen updates;no invented NCU zero-byte counters
measurement.physical: Legacy swap/H2D fields explicitly renamed sequential reference quantities;true API/launch/metadata/row payload ledgers distinct;exact traffic only from available profilers

stop: First source/isolation/runtime/quality failure;preserve passed/failed/unexecuted entries,no automatic replacement
decision: About25% operator and10% W2 are value reference lines,not blanket mechanism vetoes;ordinary batching explaining the gain means engineering-only;uncovered scope stays unknown
controller_interruption: Guard is a separate session;controller forwards one SIGINT and awaits finally cleanup. CPU tests cover PID and group signals after observer first-byte readiness.

semantics.primary: Strict sequential-swap final ownership AND all allocated database vector bytes,including retired rows;all per-ACK visibility and occurrence IDs unchanged
semantics.observable: Weaker observable equivalence also follows;not substituted for strict compatibility
semantics.invalid: Empty,duplicate IDs,nonlive,out-of-range and >512 batches rejected before mutation
semantics.concurrency: Serial Host-ready ACK;no concurrent observers inside an erase

mechanisms.WAVES: Native operations partitioned into RAW/WAW/WAR-safe levels,each submitted by CUDA13.1 cudaMemcpyBatchAsync;no copy elimination
mechanisms.FINAL: Compose original-tail provenance for ALL changed allocated rows,including retired rows;prove final sources disjoint from distinct destinations;one metadata H2D+one coalesced kernel+one stream sync;nativeB1 and one-final-move dispatch

progression.CPU: Exhaustive N<=8 plus randomized/invalid and native full-W2 inventory before CUDA
progression.screen: 2 balanced rounds,three D512 processes each;continue primary if either mechanism improves both native means by about25%,or a recorded broader state-work reduction justifies it;not novelty admission
progression.primary: 6 balanced rounds of9microcells*3 +5service controls(S1,original frozenPDX CURRENT,new audited NATIVE,WAVES,FINAL);all observations retained;originalCURRENT is the external same-campaign anchor
progression.extension: 54 synthetic shape processes,6 rounds*3shapes*3variants;both D128/D960 per process
progression.profile: 6 NSYS(native/WAVES/FINAL D512 andW2) +4NCU(FINAL update +NATIVE/WAVES/FINAL W2 query);separate from public ACK
